notes_appends.text: [Episode 8 research 2026-11-28] Marriage date 8 Apr 1938 and burial at Harmony United Methodist Church Cemetery are from her funeral program (Harmony United Methodist Church, Millsboro; program text preserved in the Mitsawokett obituaries collection, contributed by Henrietta Carey Johnson). The program records that she worked for the Steins at Stuart-Kingston's in Rehoboth for about 15 years; was a dedicated member of Harmony United Methodist Church (Young Adults, Women's Society, United Methodist Women, Sunday School, Vacation Bible School, Methodist Youth Fellowship, committees, church dining hall, former conference delegate); was a member of the Nanticoke Indian Association; and that she and Harry reared four girls besides their daughter Sheila: Diana, Daliene (known as Chippy), Jodie and Jessie. Her Social Security file names her parents as John Clarke and Lula Carey; her Delaware birth record names John W. Clark and Lulu Carey. The former child link to John Clark (3591) was removed by this package: no record names him as her father, and a man who died in 1918 cannot be the father of her siblings born in the 1920s; whether profile 3591 is a different man or a duplicate of John Wesley Clark Jr (8193) remains open.

[Episode 8 research 2026-11-28] Dates corrected by this package. The former Death fact date '1 Feb 1932' came from the GEDCOM layer and is disproven: he married in 1938, his daughter Sheila was born in 1939, he registered for the draft in 1940 and served in the US Army in World War II, and his VA gravesite record and Social Security file both give 31 Jan 1999. His birth is 22 Aug 1916 (Social Security file, VA record, draft card). His parentage is record-confirmed: his Social Security file names Morris Davis and Hester Morris, and the 1920 census places him in his widowed mother Hester's household. The FindAGrave memorial number in the earlier notes (36969032) could not be verified in Nov 2026; the VA gravesite record is the burial source of record.
